title: Database Indexes And Search
summary: Learn how database indexes, PostgreSQL HOT update performance, full text search, trigram fuzzy matching, and hybrid search queries behave under production constraints.
audience: Backend, full-stack, and platform engineers who need practical judgment for database indexes and search queries.

units.title: Index Fundamentals
units.summary: Build the mental model for B-tree, GIN, GiST, BRIN, expression, partial, and covering indexes.

units.title: PostgreSQL HOT Updates
units.summary: Understand same-page Heap-Only Tuple chains, index eligibility, fillfactor, pruning, vacuuming, and production monitoring.

units.title: PostgreSQL Full Text Search
units.summary: Understand tsvector, tsquery, websearch input, weighted vectors, GIN indexes, and ranking behavior.

units.title: Trigram Fuzzy Indexes
units.summary: Use pg_trgm, similarity thresholds, gin_trgm_ops, and expression indexes for typo-tolerant text search.

units.title: Hybrid Search Query
units.summary: Walk through a production-style query that combines full text search and trigram candidates.
